title: Season 3 desert and King City matchups are filled in
summary: Season 3's two cross-server matchmaking tables go from empty to populated: 32 desert match groups and 64 King City pairings. These rows decide which servers are grouped or paired against one another in those season 3 events; no event rules, rewards, text or art changed alongside them.
highlights: s03_desert_match gains 32 entries (ids 1-32), each naming four server ids and an outpost flag.
s03_kingcity_match gains 64 entries (ids 1-64), each pairing one server against another.
Both tables were previously empty, so this is the season 3 bracket being seeded rather than an existing bracket being rebalanced.
